title: Audit
description: Control-plane audit log: every account and limit change, newest first. The actor, action, source, and a short human-readable summary are recorded for each operation.

filter.advancedDescription: Filter by actor, source, event time, and event type. Account, asset, and exact-ID filters stay online in the filter bar.

columnDescriptions.externalId: This column shows the immutable audit entry ID.
columnDescriptions.time: This column shows when the audited event was recorded.
columnDescriptions.actor: This column shows the operator or integration that caused the event.
columnDescriptions.action: This column shows the audited operation type.
columnDescriptions.account: This column shows the account affected by the event when one is present.
columnDescriptions.source: This column shows whether the event came from the panel, REST, MCP, or another source.
columnDescriptions.detail: This column shows a short human-readable summary of the event.

hint.filtered: No entries match the current filters.
hint.blank: Account and limit changes will appear here as operators make them.
